quotes.text: Bug 1890731 added TreeDataAdapter and TreeDataRow to hold row data and respond to the TreeView contract, while existing nsITreeView users migrated in stages. The adapter owns row count, cell text/value/properties, parent and level, expansion, selection callbacks, and tree notifications. New code should inspect current TreeDataAdapter before implementing a separate tree model. The current class still exists but now uses a flat-row cache rather than the first commit’s fully flat storage.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
